function takeText(a: string, b: number) { console.log(a, b); }
function generic<T>(a: string, b: T) { console.log(a, b); }
let plain: string | number = "plain";
takeText(plain, plain = 1);
let inferred: string | number = "inferred";
generic(inferred, inferred = 2);
let immediate: string | number = "immediate";
((a: string, b: number) => console.log(a, b))(immediate, immediate = 3);
let spread: string | number = "spread";
takeText(spread.toUpperCase(), ...([spread = 4] as [number]));
let deleted: { p?: number } | string;
let deleteSelector: { p?: number } | string = { p: 1 };
delete (deleted = deleteSelector)[deleteSelector = "p"];
console.log(deleted.p);
type Method = { label: string; m(this: Method): void };
let receiver: Method | string;
let selected: Method | string = { label: "method", m() { console.log(this.label); } };
(receiver = selected)[selected = "m"]();
receiver.m();
function values(message: string): number[] { console.log(message); return []; }
let index: string | number = "indexed";
values(index.toUpperCase())[index = 5] = 1;
console.log(index.toFixed(1));
let body: string | number = 0;
console.log(((ignored) => body.toUpperCase())(body = "after"));
((ignored) => { body = 0; })(body = "new");
console.log(body.toFixed(1));
let spreadState: string | number = "before";
console.log(((first, second) => second.toFixed(1))(...([spreadState = 3] as [number]), spreadState));
spreadState = 4;
console.log(((first, second) => second.toUpperCase())(...([spreadState = "after"] as [string]), spreadState));
let compound: string | number = 0;
const valuesToWrite = [0];
valuesToWrite[compound = 0] += (compound = "numeric").length;
console.log(compound.toUpperCase(), valuesToWrite[0]);

let logical: string | number = 0;
const logicalTargets = [0];
logicalTargets[logical = 0] ||= (logical = "logical").length;
if (typeof logical === "string") console.log(logical.toUpperCase(), logicalTargets[0]);

let update: string | number = "before";
const updateTargets = [1];
updateTargets[update = 0]++;
console.log(update.toFixed(1), updateTargets[0]);

let savedKey: string | number = "before";
const patternValues = [0];
[patternValues[savedKey = 0]] = [(savedKey = "last").length];
if (typeof savedKey === "string") console.log(savedKey.toUpperCase());
console.log(patternValues[0], savedKey);
